author: PostmodernJukebox
description:
If you’re new here, welcome. We’re a group of “old souls” on a mission to turn modern-day pop songs into classic hit records from a bygone era.

We're bringing our vintage musical universe to 60 US cities this Fall! See the list & get your tix for a night of "Old School" entertainment: http://www.pmjtour.com
